runs.text: Brand & product designer making calm, useful things.
Ten years shaping identities and interfaces for climate startups, museums and independent publishers. Based in Lisbon, working everywhere.
I believe good design feels inevitable — like it could never have been any other way.
Before going independent I led design at two early-stage startups and taught typography at ESAD. I work best in small teams, close to the people who build.
Strategy, naming, logo and visual systems
Research, UX flows and polished UI
